variants.headline: Still in view: assembly votes the government out
variants.sub: The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

The government has been voted out. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.
